summary: This proposed standard describes the part of the CDNI Control interface that lets an upstream CDN trigger activity in a downstream CDN, for example to pre-position metadata or content or to remove it. It is used when the downstream CDN delivers content on the upstream CDN's behalf.

eli5.summary: A shop owner can tell a partner shop to stock up on an item or clear it off shelves. This defines how one content network sends such requests to another.
